exposure: Surgical procedures (hernia repair, colonoscopy, appendectomy, cesarean delivery)
cohort: Patients undergoing one of four index procedures: hernia repair, colonoscopy, appendectomy, and cesarean delivery
finding: This study highlights the limitations of facility-level comparisons in surgical quality between rural and referral centers, and proposes a methodological approach using population-level data, risk stratification, tests of noninferiority, and Firth logistic regression analysis to overcome these limitations.
mod_finding: The study included cesarean delivery as one of the index procedures analyzed.
